extra_quotes: All the nonlinear optical measurements were conducted with a femtosecond laser system, which consists of a Ti: sapphire amplifier (Libra, Coherent) and an optical parametric amplifier (OPA).
To investigate the femtosecond active control of harmonic polarization, a non-collinear pump-probe configuration was constructed.
